Person scope

Paid narrative

People and shared context

SOURCE LANGUAGE

Different sources can sit in one system without becoming the same kind of evidence.

+
Measured / task-based

What happened in a bounded task or standardized measure.

+

How you describe your own experience or tendencies.

Human review with explicit role, scope, date and responsibility.
